snippet_primary: "The following products and activities are not allowed on Gumroad. This is almost always because they violate U.S. federal law, they are prohibited by card network rules, or they are restricted by our payment processing partners. If you are unsure whether your content is prohibited on Gumroad, please contact us at support@gumroad.com with a description or example of the content."
subject_exact: Gumroad prohibited items policy basis (US federal law, card network rules, payment processor restrictions)
